# `adt context`

Get compressed dependency context for an ABAP object

```bash
adt context [options] <objectName>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument       | Description      | Default |
| -------------- | ---------------- | ------- |
| `<objectName>` | ABAP object name |         |

**Options**

| Option                 | Description                                     | Default |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--type <type>`        | Object type hint (CLAS, INTF, PROG, DDLS, FUNC) |         |
| `--depth <depth>`      | Dependency depth (1..3)                         | `1`     |
| `--max-deps <maxDeps>` | Maximum dependencies to include                 | `20`    |
| `--json`               | Output as JSON                                  | `true`  |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
